trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. There is nothing to grind for this one directly: work the roadmap stages in order, protect the single missable meditation in Chapter 1, and let the 100% checklist carry most of the list.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

steps.text: Earn the other 54 trophies; the platinum is awarded automatically, with no separate objective of its own.
Plan one single playthrough: every guide we checked rates the list at one minimum playthrough with zero online trophies.
Budget roughly 200 hours; the long pole is the 100% checklist behind A Long Road, not the story.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It cannot be skipped: play the prologue through to its end and the trophy lands as the mission closes.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

steps.text: Start a new game and play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, from the first cutscene.
Follow the mission markers to the end; there are no optional objectives or medals tied to it.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen, before Chapter 1 proper begins.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Before you close the chapter, protect the run's one missable moment: the balcony meditation at Jason's house that feeds Positive Mental Attitude (see that trophy and the watch list).
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

steps.text: Play through Chapter 1's story missions in order; chapter trophies pop automatically at the chapter end.
After the mission Down to Earth, return to Jason's house in the morning and accept Lucia's meditation invitation on the balcony.
Complete that balcony meditation before finishing the chapter: it is the only currently identified missable trophy interaction.
Finish the chapter finale and the trophy pops as Chapter 2 opens.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. The asterisks are in the official name as PlayStation publishes it. Use the chapter to start your long-term habits: WAiNK scans and vehicle discoveries made during the story still count toward the post-story checklist.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

steps.text: Complete every Chapter 2 story mission; the trophy pops at the chapter's closing mission.
As new activity types unlock, try each once so Master of None is mostly done by mid-story.
Scan vehicles and points of interest with the WAiNK app whenever you pass them; progress banks silently toward the 100% checklist.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. By now most side systems are open: stranger strands, robberies and races can all be started, and everything you finish early is one less cleanup item after the credits.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

steps.text: Complete the Chapter 3 story missions in order; the trophy pops at the chapter end.
Pick up stranger strands as their icons appear; several character quest lines begin around this part of the story.
Keep a robbery rotation going between missions to build the fencing totals the checklist will ask for later.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. An optional mission in this chapter opens up bank jobs, which is the gate to the vault robberies behind Maximum Withdrawal, so do not leave Chapter 4 without starting that thread.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

steps.text: Complete the Chapter 4 story missions; the trophy pops at the chapter end.
Play the optional mission that introduces bank jobs during this chapter; vault work depends on it.
Begin hitting bank vaults as they open: five escapes earn Maximum Withdrawal and eight vaults are needed for 100%.

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of Chapter 5 and roll the credits. There is no mission replay afterwards, but free-roam continues and almost everything else on the list stays available, so the finale is a beginning, not a point of no return.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps.text: Push through Chapter 5 to the final mission; the story runs five chapters in total.
Before the finale, tidy up any character quest lines you want closed; the game returns you to free-roam afterwards.
Complete the final mission and watch the credits; the gold pops at the end.
After the credits, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion: the checklist that drives the rest of the platinum is now visible.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Breakfast Run. It is awarded for finishing the mission itself; no medal, time or optional objective is attached.
trophies.name: Trust

steps.text: Accept the Breakfast Run mission when it is offered during the story.
Complete the mission's objectives and reach its end cutscene.
The trophy pops on the mission-complete screen.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for The Cartel Heist, the campaign's big set-piece robbery. Finishing the heist is enough; the take and your approach do not change the trophy.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

steps.text: Reach and start The Cartel Heist in the story sequence.
Play the heist through its escape phase to the closing cutscene.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Child's Play. Awarded on completion, with no extra conditions published in the official description.
trophies.name: Family Matters

steps.text: Start Child's Play when it appears in the mission sequence.
Finish the mission's objectives through to the end cutscene.
The trophy pops on the mission-complete screen.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Headliners (some fan lists misprint the trophy name; the official name is DWNFALL). Completion is the only requirement.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

steps.text: Start Headliners when the story offers it.
Complete the mission through its final objective.
The trophy pops on the mission-complete screen.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for VCIA Takedown, the airport operation. The airport area also hosts the unrelated Catch Me If You Can moment, which is a separate free-roam trophy and not part of this mission.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

steps.text: Start VCIA Takedown when it appears in the story.
Complete the takedown and its escape sequence.
The trophy pops on the mission-complete screen.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for Operation Savage Glory. Awarded simply for completing the mission as part of the campaign.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

steps.text: Start Operation Savage Glory in the story sequence.
Finish the operation's objectives through the end cutscene.
The trophy pops on the mission-complete screen.

trophies.guide: The hardest and longest trophy on the list. The checklist only becomes visible after the story (Progress, Stats, 100% Completion), but progress made during the story already counts. Despite the name it is closer to 60% of everything the game holds: most categories ask for a fraction of their totals, and nothing on it is missable after the credits.
trophies.name: A Long Road

steps.text: Finish the story first: the checklist unlocks only after the credits, under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion.
Clear the Story and Tasks block: story done, 100 optional tasks, 39 of 39 gang operations, 22 of 22 bank jobs, 7 of 7 payday loan jobs, 34 smash 'n' grabs and 50 stick ups.
Hit the fencing totals: $100,000 narcotics, $100,000 jewelry, $250,000 marked bills, $200,000 vehicles, and 8 of 8 vaults hit.

Work the Exploration block: 5 of 7 Kenton sets, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 underwater discoveries, 30 magazines/books/comics, 15 meditation spots, 100 cocaine flamingos, 70 styles, 30 unique races, 42 shooting range golds, 42 drone time trials, 300 stunts and 70 of 80 challenges.
Finish the Discovery block: scan 200 base model vehicles with the WAiNK app, find 50 standard issue weapons, and study 100 animals through binoculars.
When every line reads complete, the gold pops; guides put the full platinum route at roughly 200 hours, most of it here.

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 stunts across the four stunt families. The game holds 397 in total (130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps), and the 100% checklist will later ask for 300, so treat 300 as your real target and this trophy lands on the way.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

steps.text: Learn the four stunt families: stunt jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps; all four count toward the same total.
Chain stunt jumps and bridge flights during normal travel instead of grinding them in one sitting.
Keep going past 250 to 300: the 100% checklist requires 300 of the 397 stunts, so stopping at the trophy wastes a second grind.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample all nine activity types once each: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. You only have to try them, not win or medal, so knock this out as each type unlocks during the story.
trophies.name: Master of None

steps.text: Note the nine activity types to sample: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt.
Play one session of each type as it unlocks; a single attempt registers the type.
Check off the last missing type in free-roam and the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold-medal all 42 shooting range challenges, split between the Griffin range and Rodgers Ranch. The same 42 golds are required in full by the 100% checklist, so there is no shortcut version of this one: learn each weapon class's rhythm and replay until the medal turns gold.
trophies.name: The Shootist

steps.text: Find both ranges: the 42 challenges split between Griffin and Rodgers Ranch.
Clear every challenge at any medal first to learn target patterns, then replay for gold.
Gold the final challenge and the trophy pops; the same 42 golds also satisfy the checklist line in full.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location. Winning, not just entering, is required at each spot. Separately, the 100% checklist tracks 42 drone time trials, so expect to spend real time with the drone beyond this trophy.
trophies.name: Top Fun

steps.text: Visit each Top Fun drone race location on the map and enter the race.
Win at every location; a loss does not register, so retry until you take first place.
After the last location's win the trophy pops; keep flying if you are chasing the 42 drone time trials on the checklist.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races: repeats of the same race do not add to the count. The checklist later wants 30 unique race wins plus race challenge golds, so spread your wins across the map from the start instead of farming one easy circuit.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

steps.text: Enter races across different map locations; only distinct races count toward the 20.
Win each one; finishing without winning does not advance the counter.
At 20 unique wins the trophy pops; continue to 30 unique wins for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal, the fishing character, in one of his fishing challenges. Fishing is also one of the nine activity types for Master of None and Cal's fishing tasks count among the optional tasks, so his challenges are worth doing beyond this trophy.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

steps.text: Meet Cal and unlock his fishing challenges during free-roam or optional tasks.
Enter a fishing challenge against Cal and learn the catch timing on a first attempt.
Out-catch him in a challenge and the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game at any arcade cabinet. The checklist asks for four different video games played for 100%, so try a different cabinet each time you pass one and both goals advance together.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

steps.text: Find an arcade cabinet in an interior and start a game.
Play it through to completion once; score does not matter.
The trophy pops when the game ends; the checklist separately wants 4 video games played.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's character quest line by completing his final mission. Andy's strand is Lucia-only, so switch to Lucia if his missions stop appearing. His line also feeds the Strangers & Freaks count.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

steps.text: Start Andy's strand when his icon appears, playing as Lucia: his quests are Lucia-only.
Work through each of his missions as they unlock between story beats.
Complete his final mission and the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's character quest line. Kenton is also the diving and treasure contact: his sets and the underwater discoveries tied to his thread are part of the 100% checklist, so his line pays off twice.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

steps.text: Start Kenton's strand when it appears and follow his diving and treasure jobs.
Complete his sets as you go: the checklist wants 5 of 7 Kenton sets and all 33 underwater discoveries.
Finish his final mission and the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's character quest line by completing his final mission. Like the other character lines, it counts toward the eight strands needed for Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

steps.text: Pick up Billy's strand when his icon appears on the map.
Complete each of his missions as the strand unfolds.
Finish his final mission and the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight full stranger mission strands anywhere in Leonida. The character lines (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret's hunting thread) are the backbone: finish those six and any two further strands. Which minor strands qualify is still being pinned down by guide writers, so finish strands rather than abandoning them half-done.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

steps.text: Treat a strand as the whole quest line for one stranger, not a single mission: only completed strands count.
Finish the six named character lines first: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret.
Complete any two additional stranger strands you meet in free-roam to reach eight.
The silver pops when the eighth strand closes; strands can be finished after the story.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's character quest line. Randy's delivery work also counts among the optional tasks the 100% checklist tallies, so his strand is efficient progress on two fronts.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

steps.text: Start Randy's strand when it appears and take his delivery jobs.
Complete each mission in his line as it unlocks.
Finish his final mission and the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's character quest line. Tyrone's strand is Jason-only, so if his missions vanish from your map, switch to Jason. His lab jobs also count as optional tasks.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

steps.text: Start Tyrone's strand playing as Jason: his quests are Jason-only.
Work through his missions, including the lab jobs, as they appear.
Complete his final mission and the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. This is the list's one identified missable: the first spot is a Chapter 1 story moment on the balcony of Jason's house, offered once by Lucia after the mission Down to Earth, and it does not come back. The 100% checklist only needs 15 spots, but the trophy needs all 18, so never skip one.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

steps.text: In Chapter 1, after Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning and accept her invitation to meditate on the balcony.
Complete that balcony meditation before leaving Chapter 1: it is the only spot that cannot be recovered later.
Meditate at every other marked spot as you explore; spots are spread across the whole state.
At 18 of 18 the trophy pops; note the checklist line only asks for 15, so the trophy is the stricter target.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Complete Bret's hunting request by taking down the unique animal he sends you after. Bret's wider hunting work matters too: his 15 Target Decks are a full requirement on the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Fair Game

steps.text: Meet Bret and take on his hunting jobs; his strand is one of the named character lines.
Accept the unique-animal hunt and track the animal using the hunting tools and binoculars.
Make the kill and report back to Bret; the trophy pops on completion.
Keep doing his Target Decks afterwards: all 15 are required for 100%.

trophies.guide: Complete any three full collectible card sets. There are 18 sets in the game and the 100% checklist wants 15 of them, so this trophy is only the warm-up: collect cards whenever you enter an interior and keep sets balanced rather than finishing one area at a time.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

steps.text: Pick up every collectible card you spot in interiors; cards belong to themed sets tracked in the progress menus.
Complete your first three full sets to earn the silver.
Do not stop at three: the 100% checklist requires 15 of the 18 sets.

trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK phone app: landmarks, curiosities and sculptures all count. The app prompts you near scannable spots, and the same 100 scans are a checklist requirement, so make scanning a reflex whenever the prompt appears.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

steps.text: Watch for the WAiNK prompt near landmarks and points of interest and scan every one you pass.
Scan while travelling for other goals; 100 scans accumulate quickly across the story if you never skip the prompt.
The silver pops at 100 locations, which also completes the matching checklist line.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's 80 challenges. The checklist raises the bar to 70 of 80, which still lets you skip the ten hardest, so pick off the quick challenges first and leave the brutal ones for last, or forever.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

steps.text: Open the challenges list and sort by what you can finish immediately; quick completions build the count fast.
Complete 50 challenges for the trophy.
Push on to 70 of 80 for the 100% checklist; you may skip the ten hardest challenges entirely.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: While playing with your partner along, raise a four-star wanted level, then lose it completely and escape. Both halves matter: reaching four stars is not enough, the stars must fully clear while your partner is with you.
trophies.name: Hot Together

steps.text: Be in free-roam with your partner accompanying you.
Commit crimes in view of police until the wanted level reaches four stars.
Break line of sight and hide until the stars drain completely; the trophy pops once you have escaped the heat.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner present, keeping a wanted level alive the whole chain. Plan a tight triangle of shops, move fast between them, and never let the stars fully clear until the third till is empty.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

steps.text: Pick three shops close together and bring your partner along.
Rob the first shop and keep your wanted level active as you leave; losing it resets the chain.
Rob the second and third shops back-to-back without the wanted level dropping; the trophy pops after the third.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Scanning with the WAiNK app is the engine of the wider goal: the checklist wants 200 of the 277 base model vehicles scanned, and boats and aircraft can be scanned too, so scan every new model you see from the first hour.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

steps.text: Scan every unfamiliar vehicle with the WAiNK app; each new model discovered adds to the count.
Vary your hunting grounds: richer districts, docks and airfields spawn models the story route never shows.
At 100 discovered the trophy pops; the checklist target is 200 of 277 base models, so keep scanning.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down five enemies during one Combat Focus activation. Set it up deliberately: find a gang operation or robbery gone loud with at least five enemies clustered, top up your focus, then trigger it and work fast before the effect ends.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

steps.text: Find a fight with at least five enemies close together, such as a gang operation or a loud robbery.
Enter the fight with a full Combat Focus meter and weapons already loaded.
Trigger Combat Focus once and take down five enemies before it expires; the trophy pops on the fifth.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, make an unscheduled departure: get airborne in a plane you were never cleared to take. Steal an aircraft from the airfield and lift off; the trophy is about the departure, not the destination.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

steps.text: Head to VCIA, the airport, in free-roam and find a usable aircraft on the field.
Board the aircraft without any mission or clearance context; expect a wanted level.
Take off and leave the airport; the trophy pops as the unscheduled departure registers.

trophies.guide: The joke trophy about the Rhino tank: get into a Rhino and survive its heat, in every sense. Rhinos appear at high wanted levels and military sites; commandeer one and stay alive inside it while the pressure is on.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

steps.text: Find a Rhino tank: they respond at high wanted levels and guard military locations.
Clear its crew or approach unseen, then take control of the tank.
Ride out the heat inside the Rhino; the trophy pops once the encounter registers.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store in complete stealth: no detection from entry to exit. Jewelry stores are also smash 'n' grab targets for the checklist and their stock feeds the jewelry fencing total, but for this trophy the loud approach voids it, so go quiet or go home.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

steps.text: Choose a jewelry store and approach quietly, ideally at a calm moment with no police nearby.
Enter and loot without being spotted by staff, guards or cameras; if detection triggers, leave and reset.
Exit undetected with the goods and the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape each time. Bank jobs unlock through an optional mission in Chapter 4, and there are eight vaults in total: the checklist wants all eight hit, so this silver is again a waypoint rather than the finish line.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

steps.text: Unlock bank jobs via the optional mission that introduces them in Chapter 4.
Rob a bank vault and escape the police response; a vault only counts with a clean getaway.
Repeat at five different vaults for the silver, then finish all eight for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Stop an armored truck, crack it open, take the cash and escape the response. Armored trucks roam the map as dynamic events; block one with a heavy vehicle, deal with the guards, and be gone before the wanted level peaks.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

steps.text: Watch for an armored truck on the roads and cut it off with a sturdy vehicle.
Neutralise the guards and open the rear doors to take the cash.
Escape until the wanted level clears; the trophy pops after the getaway.

trophies.guide: Visit all 52 areas of Leonida. Exploration happens naturally across a 200-hour platinum run; if any grey patches remain on the map late in the run, a helicopter tour of the untouched corners finishes it quickly.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

steps.text: Reveal the map as you travel for story and checklist goals; each new area registers on entry.
Check the map for unvisited areas once the story is done and sweep them by car, boat and air.
Enter the 52nd area and the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob at least one illegal operation run by each of the nine gangs. Gang operations are a much bigger checklist category (all 39 must be cleared for 100%), so variety early helps twice: tag which gang owns each operation and spread your hits across all nine.
trophies.name: Pest Control

steps.text: Identify gang operations on the map; they are marked with yellow icons and tied to specific gangs.
Rob one operation belonging to each of the nine different gangs, noting which gangs you have covered.
The trophy pops when the ninth gang's operation is robbed; the checklist still wants all 39 operations cleared.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: A quiet moment trophy: order a cocktail at a beachfront spot on Ocean Beach and take in the view. It is a deliberate nod to the series' roots, and it takes less than a minute once you are standing at the bar.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

steps.text: Travel to Ocean Beach, the beachfront strip, in free-roam.
Find a beachfront bar or cocktail spot overlooking the water and order a cocktail.
Drink it with the view in front of you; the trophy pops as the moment completes.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal a car from inside a vehicle showroom and drive it out through the glass. Pick a showroom with a display car you fancy, get in, and exit through the window rather than the door.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

steps.text: Enter a vehicle showroom with display cars inside.
Get into a display vehicle; expect the theft to draw attention.
Accelerate out through the showroom glass; the trophy pops as you smash through.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley and follow through, in the game's own joking words. Bowling sits among the leisure activities; a single visit and a played game is what the moment asks for.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

steps.text: Travel to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Start a bowling game at the lanes.
Play your throws with a full follow-through motion; the trophy pops as the game registers.

trophies.guide: A hidden partnership moment between the two protagonists, described only as a partnership with mass appeal. These vague hidden trophies resolve through story and partner play: keep both protagonists active, take partner activities when offered, and it lands as their partnership peaks.
trophies.name: Personal Best

steps.text: Keep playing story and partner content with both Jason and Lucia; this hidden trophy is tied to their partnership.
Take partner activities and joint moments when the game offers them instead of skipping ahead.
The trophy pops when the partnership moment completes; if it has not landed by the finale, finish remaining partner content in free-roam.

trophies.guide: PlayStation tracks a running count of choices for this trophy, up to 500. It is a slow-burn accumulation trophy rather than a single moment: dialogue decisions, approach choices and free-roam decisions all feed it across the whole playthrough.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

steps.text: Make decisions whenever the game offers them, in story dialogue and free-roam encounters alike; the tracker counts choices, not correct answers.
Do not reload to second-guess choices: the count grows by choosing, for better or worse, as the description says.
The trophy pops when the tracked choice count reaches its target over the course of the run.

trophies.guide: Fail at something, then succeed at the same thing on the second attempt. The natural way it happens is a race or challenge lost and immediately re-run and won; if it never triggers organically, engineer it by deliberately dropping a quick challenge and winning the retry.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

steps.text: Pick a short, repeatable challenge or race you can attempt twice in a row.
Fail the first attempt, on purpose if necessary.
Retry immediately and succeed; the trophy pops on the second-time success.

trophies.guide: Witness one of Leonida's strange hidden events. The description gives nothing away on purpose: these moments are found by exploring odd corners of the map, especially at night, and staying to watch instead of driving on.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

steps.text: Explore remote and odd corners of Leonida, including at night, where scripted strangeness is placed.
When something inexplicable starts, stay and watch it play out rather than leaving.
The trophy pops once you have witnessed the event in full.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock a pedestrian down with a melee attack delivered from a moving vehicle, a drive-by swat rather than a collision. Line up a lone pedestrian, keep the speed modest, and swing as you pass: running them over with the car itself does not count.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

steps.text: Find a lone pedestrian on a quiet street and approach in a car at moderate speed.
Use the melee drive-by attack as you pass so your character strikes them from the vehicle.
If they go down from the hit, the trophy pops; a plain vehicle collision does not count.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Fence a cumulative $250,000 of marked bills through your fence contacts. Marked bills come from bank jobs, payday loan jobs and vaults, and the identical $250,000 figure is a 100% checklist line, so your robbery economy and this trophy are the same work.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

steps.text: Run bank jobs, payday loan jobs and vault robberies, which pay out in marked bills.
Sell the marked bills to fence contacts rather than spending them raw; only fenced totals count.
At $250,000 fenced the trophy pops, completing the matching checklist line at the same time.

trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across all shops: clothes, weapons, vehicles services, food and leisure all count. Across a 200-hour run this arrives on its own if you actually use the shops instead of hoarding cash for properties.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

steps.text: Spend normally at every shop type as you play; the counter is cumulative across all shops.
Outfit both protagonists and keep vehicles serviced to move the total along.
The trophy pops when lifetime shop spending crosses $100,000.

trophies.guide: Buy all eight garage properties for sale across Leonida. This is a money trophy in disguise: fund it with the robbery and fencing economy from Stage 4 rather than grinding small jobs.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

steps.text: Note the garage properties as their for-sale signs appear across the map.
Build the purchase fund through robberies and fencing, the same economy behind Dime on the Dollar.
Buy the eighth and final garage and the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Registration is done through the phone app on vehicles you use, so register each new car you keep rather than waiting for a special moment.
trophies.name: On the Spot

steps.text: Open the Scooter Bros app on the in-game phone and find the vehicle registration option.
Register vehicles you own or keep as you acquire them.
Register the tenth vehicle and the trophy pops.
